dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, localized solid light-grey pixel clusters without internal gradients, concentrated primarily on the lower lateral flank and the neck region, appearing as asymmetrical 'splatter' patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated obtuse triangle roughly parallel to the spine; a secondary grouping of four high-intensity blobs near the cranial fold forms an irregular trapezoid.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, vertical linear indentation or cleft is visible on the left-most posterior appendage; a distinct patch of raised, irregular white texture is visible on the upper-most dorsal appendage.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated circular grey-blue spot is positioned on the mid-lateral flank, approximately one-third of the body length from the left posterior edge.
